authorityReview.reason: The zero-overlap width is a geometric threshold, not an observed or authorized road width. Existing photos only show the near paving and cannot establish both road edges, a centerline offset, or a private/ground-floor interpretation.

split collision to conceal the physical footprint-to-road overlap

promote Hero, Identity, MCP3, or three-tier runtime
minimumUnlockEvidence: A surveyed, cadastral, owner, or architect plan at the Building 4 frontage with both road edges, centerline or an offset/dimension chain, scale, date, provenance, and measurement uncertainty.
Or a geolocatable orthophoto or field measurement that distinguishes 4.5757706075 m from the current 6.75 m rendering and records both road edges plus uncertainty.
A complete OSM full-history and parent relation/member dump may inform a new review, but absent measured width or boundary evidence it cannot authorize a renderer change.
decision: The 0.4026350727 scene-unit overlap remains a formal map blocker. Retain accepted Massing/MCP1/runtime diagnostic stages, do not rerun them, and do not model or modify public contracts.
